map.生长度日（GDD）累积有效温度，用于预测作物发育阶段。简单平均法以「日均温 −: GDD accumulates effective temperature to predict crop development stages. The simple average uses "mean temp - base temp", capped at the upper bound and 0 below the lower bound. The single-sine method takes alpha = (Tmax - Tmin)/2, finds intersection angles theta1, theta2 of the temp curve with the bounds via arcsine, and integrates analytically as ((Tavg - Tbase)(theta2 - theta1) + alpha(cos theta1 - cos theta2)/2) x 2 / pi, more accurate for large day-night swings. Accumulate daily and compare with target GDD for phenological progress.

map.GDD 比天数准在哪？: Where is GDD more accurate than days?
map.作物发育由『热量』驱动而非日历。暖春发育快，GDD 累计先达阈值即成熟，比固定天: Crop development is driven by heat not calendar. Warm springs develop faster; GDD hits the threshold first and matures, more stable across years than fixed days.
